original_value: This paper proposes a method for sensor validation and fault detection in wind turbines. Ensuring validity of sensor measurements is a significant part in overall condition monitoring as sensor faults lead to incorrect results in monitoring a system’s state of health. Although identifying abrupt failures in sensors is relatively straightforward, calibration drifts are more difficult to detect. Therefore, a detection and isolation technique for sensor calibration drifts on the purpose of measurement validation was developed. Temperature sensor measurements from the Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system of a wind turbine were used for this aim. Low output rate of the measurements and nonlinear characteristics of the system drive the necessity to design an advanced fault detection algorithm. Artificial neural networks were chosen for this purpose considering their high performance in nonlinear environments. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively detect existence of calibration drift and isolate the exact sensor with faulty behaviour.

result.paraphrase: This paper presents a method for wind-turbine sensor validation and fault detection. Verifying sensor measurement validity is a key part of condition monitoring, since sensor faults can produce incorrect system health assessments. While abrupt sensor failures are relatively easy to identify, calibration drifts are harder to detect. To address this, a technique was developed to detect and isolate sensor calibration drift for measurement validation. The approach used temperature sensor data from the wind turbine’s Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system. Because the measurements have a low output rate and the system exhibits nonlinear behavior, an advanced fault-detection algorithm was needed. Artificial neural networks were selected due to their strong performance in nonlinear settings. The results show that the proposed method can effectively detect calibration drift and pinpoint the sensor exhibiting faulty behavior.
